description: The multiple LINE clause (§2023:13.18.35.3 SR10) — more than one operand defines a set of report lines at possibly-unequal vertical intervals. LIVE (kb/Work PB565): §2023:13.18.35.4 GR9 makes it "functionally equivalent to a LINE clause with a single operand, together with a simple OCCURS clause whose integer is equal to the number of operands of the LINE clause", so the binder builds exactly that — a simple, STEP-less, VERTICAL repeating entry whose per-repetition operand the LINE clause supplies — and it drives the same subtree replay as §2023:13.18.38 format 3. SR10 a/b/c/d are enforced on COBOL2199. The COBOL-85 LINE clause was the single-operand LINE NUMBER IS, so the multi-operand form AND the LINES / NUMBERS / ARE spellings of §2023:13.18.35.2 Format 1 (kb/Work PB1221: the keyword prefix is the closed brace LINE NUMBER IS | LINE NUMBERS ARE | LINES ARE) are introduction-gated (0900 below 2002).
display: multiple LINE / the LINES, NUMBERS and ARE spellings (report group description)
vcr: 2002 RW addition (the 85 LINE format is single-operand; GR9-equivalent to the report-group OCCURS)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRML1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrml1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE 2 4.
      05 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "OK".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
